data.name: Heavenward
data.detailed_description:
Sandbox Secret Realms & Layered Combat Design

Structured with tiered sandbox levels, including diverse trial scenes such as spirit valleys, immortal caves, thunder marshes and void ruins. Each realm integrates combat, puzzle-solving and random chance events. The levels feature vertical depth design, combining positioning, dodging and terrain interaction to deliver varied and strategic combat experiences.

Epic Ensemble Narrative with Classic Xianxia Charm

Centered on karmic reincarnation and the struggle between good and evil, the narrative features well-rounded companion characters and fated rivals with emotional, sweeping story arcs. Player choices shape character fates and story directions, unlocking multiple endings in the romantic oriental storytelling tradition of classic Xianxia masterpieces.

Fluid Real-Time Sword Immortal Combat

Free-target real-time combat system blending sword combos, elemental magic and sacred artifact abilities. Seamless dodging, parrying and counterattack mechanics, paired with precise hit feedback and stunning skill effects, deliver both satisfying action and deep operational depth in every immortal duel.

Complete Authentic Cultivation Progression System

Faithfully recreates the classic cultivation ladder from Qi Refining to Great Transcendence, encompassing technique enlightenment, destiny sword forging, alchemy refining and sacred artifact empowerment. With flexible growth paths, players can build their own unique combat style and cultivation philosophy.

Secret Realm Fortunes & Explorative Replayability

Every sandbox level hides random fortunes and hidden events — encounter reclusive masters to learn forbidden arts, discover ancient scrolls and rare treasures. Each run holds unexpected surprises, filling the cultivation journey with variables and a sense of adventure.

data.short_description: Tianyan is a Chinese xianxia sandbox action RPG. As a cultivator, you enter immortal realms, slay demons across stages. With classic story, fluid combat & deep cultivation, forge your own immortality legend.
